Solid points: median of all 12 paired ratios; faint triangles: six-trial graph medians. All cases, losses and full trial ranges retained.
Ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Lines connect tested sizes; no threshold interpolation. All 0 flagged calls remain included.
